binary_cases.prompt: Specify the role division and tooling blueprint for building a disposable prototype facade for a 12-panel checkout storyboard.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Must specify fidelity tier (tldraw wireframe vs Stitch high-fidelity), role division (Maker, Stitcher, Writer, Asset Collector), zero Lorem Ipsum, and 15:00 Trial Run QA.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
